mapper.sql: (SELECT count(recipes_to_tags.recipe_id) FROM recipes_to_tags WHERE recipes_to_tags.tag_id = tags.id) AS recipe_count, tags.id, tags.group_id, tags.name, tags.slug, tags.created_at, tags.update_at
mapper.select: SELECT 0 AS recipe_count, tags.id, tags.group_id, tags.name, tags.slug, tags.created_at, tags.update_at FROM tags WHERE NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipes, recipes_to_tags WHERE tags.id = recipes_to_tags.tag_id AND recipes.id = recipes_to_tags.recipe_id)) AND tags.group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tags (id, group_id, name, slug, created_at, update_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{name}, #{slug}, #{createdAt}, #{updateAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tags SET group_id = #{groupId}, name = #{name}, slug = #{slug}, update_at = #{updateAt} WHERE tags.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT tags_1.id AS tags_1_id, recipes.id AS recipes_id, recipes.slug AS recipes_slug, recipes.group_id AS recipes_group_id, recipes.user_id AS recipes_user_id, recipes.rating AS recipes_rating, recipes.name AS recipes_name, recipes.description AS recipes_description, recipes.image AS recipes_image, recipes.total_time AS recipes_total_time, recipes.prep_time AS recipes_prep_time, recipes.perform_time AS recipes_perform_time, recipes.total_time_seconds AS recipes_total_time_seconds, recipes.prep_time_seconds AS recipes_prep_time_seconds, recipes.perform_time_seconds AS recipes_perform_time_seconds, recipes.recipe_yield AS recipes_recipe_yield, recipes.recipe_yield_quantity AS recipes_recipe_yield_quantity, recipes.recipe_servings AS recipes_recipe_servings, recipes.org_url AS recipes_org_url, recipes.date_added AS recipes_date_added, recipes.date_updated AS recipes_date_updated, recipes.last_made AS recipes_last_made, recipes.name_normalized AS recipes_name_normalized, recipes.description_normalized AS recipes_description_normalized, recipes.cook_time AS recipes_cook_time, recipes."recipeCuisine" AS "recipes_recipeCuisine", recipes.is_ocr_recipe AS recipes_is_ocr_recipe, recipes.created_at AS recipes_created_at, recipes.update_at AS recipes_update_at, 0 AS anon_1, categories_1.group_id AS categories_1_group_id, categories_1.id AS categories_1_id, categories_1.name AS categories_1_name, categories_1.slug AS categories_1_slug, categories_1.created_at AS categories_1_created_at, categories_1.update_at AS categories_1_update_at, 0 AS anon_2, tools_1.id AS tools_1_id, tools_1.group_id AS tools_1_group_id, tools_1.name AS tools_1_name, tools_1.slug AS tools_1_slug, tools_1.on_hand AS tools_1_on_hand, tools_1.created_at AS tools_1_created_at, tools_1.update_at AS tools_1_update_at, 0 AS anon_3, tags_2.id AS tags_2_id, tags_2.group_id AS tags_2_group_id, tags_2.name AS tags_2_name, tags_2.slug AS tags_2_slug, tags_2.created_at AS tags_2_created_at, tags_2.update_at AS tags_2_update_at FROM tags AS tags_1 JOIN recipes_to_tags AS recipes_to_tags_1 ON tags_1.id = recipes_to_tags_1.tag_id JOIN recipes ON recipes.id = recipes_to_tags_1.recipe_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (recipes_to_categories AS recipes_to_categories_1 JOIN categories AS categories_1 ON categories_1.id = recipes_to_categories_1.category_id) ON recipes.id = recipes_to_categories_1.recipe_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (recipes_to_tools AS recipes_to_tools_1 JOIN tools AS tools_1 ON tools_1.id = recipes_to_tools_1.tool_id) ON recipes.id = recipes_to_tools_1.recipe_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (recipes_to_tags AS recipes_to_tags_2 JOIN tags AS tags_2 ON tags_2.id = recipes_to_tags_2.tag_id) ON recipes.id = recipes_to_tags_2.recipe_id WHERE tags_1.id IN (#{tagId})
